id.description: A unique identifier for the policy.

appId.description: The `appId` of the app to which the policy applies.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the policy.

orgId.description: The `orgId` of the organization to which the policy applies.

type.description:
A policy type for the policy.
 * `default` - Default policy for the org.
 * `custom` - Customized policy for an App.

personIds.description: The `personIds` for the people this policy applies to.

action.description:
The policy action.
 * `allow` - Integration usage allowed.
 * `deny` - Integration usage denied.

created.description: The date and time the policy was created.
